hero.title: The design layer for software that actually ships
hero.description: Tulip turns your product vision into a working system that powers everything from a Figma system and a production React repo, delivered in 48 hours.

metrics.manifestoText: AI finally has taste. While generic tools output un-deployable UI and traditional agencies take five weeks to draw wireframes, Tulip bridges the gap. Our engine compiles high-taste, deterministic design systems and production-ready infrastructure in exactly 48 hours.

bundle.title: The ultimate technical handoff
bundle.description: Everything your engineering team needs to start hooking up the backend today

items.title: Master Figma System
items.description: A pristine file pre-configured with strict local variables, semantic color tokens, and locked-in typography.

items.title: Production React Repo
items.description: Your exact 1:1 engineering mirror. Clean, accessible components ready to drop into any Next.js environment.

items.title: High-Legibility Typography
items.description: Standardized text for maximum readability across dense financial or analytical dashboards.

items.title: Native Iconography
items.description: We strip out generic open-source icons and embed proprietary, sharp SVGs directly into your UI blocks.

items.title: The 48-Hour Handoff
items.description: You receive a complete UI bundle. Download your Master Figma file, your synchronized GitHub repository, and your custom coded layouts, ready for your backend engineers.

sprintWorkflow.title: Zero agency bloat. Pure execution.
sprintWorkflow.description: Stop waiting weeks for wireframes and endless feedback loops. Give us your technical constraints and deploy your React codebase in 48h.

cards.title: Handling your UI DNA and the architecture
cards.description: Don't write open-ended prompts. Just fill out our strict 5-minute intake brief. Give us your primary hex codes, select your layout archetype, and check off the required features.

cards.title: Governed by taste. Compiled by AI.
cards.description: We don't blindly ship AI drafts. Our engine maps your brief to an Intermediate UI Representation (UIR). An agent audits the visual tokens, ensures the Figma variables perfectly match the repository, and verifies WCAG accessibility before handoff.

engine.title: Built for strict constraints
engine.description: We force AI to use your actual Lego bricks, not invent new ones.

features.title: Figma Native Tokens
features.description: Every layout is constructed using vetted, accessible Radix and defined UI elements. No messy, custom classes.

features.title: Token Synchronizationfolio
features.description: Your spacing, radii, and color hexes match exactly from Figma to Tailwind.

features.title: Developer Ready
features.description: Clean Next.js and React code structured for immediate backend integration.

features.title: Dark Mode Default
features.description: High-contrast, sleek aesthetics built natively into your Tailwind configuration.

features.title: Zero Lock-in
features.description: You own 100% of the Figma files and the GitHub repository.

ctaBanner.title: Ready to fix your frontend bottleneck?
ctaBanner.description: Stop wasting engineering cycles on padding and hex codes. Get back to finding product-market fit
